Hi Sophie —

Great to connect earlier today. Quick recap and the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items we discussed on the call, focused on the security review / SOC 2 package milestone so we have clear owners and dates. I attached the draft evidence list from our side (redwood_soc2-evidence-list.docx) — please let me know if you want that as a spreadsheet instead.

High-level MAP milestone (security / SOC 2 package):
- Milestone: Complete security review & deliver SOC 2 package (questionnaire + evidence)
- Target close date: 2026-07-15 (proposed)
- Responsibilities:
  - Aurelia: Fill and return SOC 2 questionnaire (Aurelia_SOC2_Questionnaire.xlsx) + provide evidence artifacts (logs, config screenshots, attestations)
  - Redwood: Package SOC 2 questionnaire responses, provide evidence list, and 1:1 technical intake with engineering for any evidence collection questions (Marcus)
- Dependencies: Legal review (Aurelia procurement), engineer time to pull logs, DocuSign for final agreement if any scope/SLAs change
- Next steps (action items):
  1) Sophie to return completed questionnaire by 2026-06-25
  2) Redwood (Marcus) to schedule intake call for evidence collection by 2026-06-22
  3) Confirm target close date and procurement touchpoint by 2026-06-26

Attachments: redwood_soc2-evidence-list.docx (attached)

If that timeline works, I can convert this into a shared MAP in HubSpot and add the milestone owners + dates. Thanks again for your time — looping Marcus and Lauren to pick up the technical and legal coordination.

Thanks — talk soon.
